name: IRF and AfRSG rolling funding call for rhino conservation
summary: Rolling grants, generally up to US$15,000, for direct African rhino conservation interventions (range expansion, biological management, practical tools) or rhino conservation plans, of the kind the IUCN African Rhino Specialist Group advises on.

status.quote: we accept proposals submitted to grants@rhinos.org on a rolling basis

geography.quote: The AfRSG's work covers all African rhino range States: Botswana, Chad, DR Congo, Eswatini, Kenya, Malawi, Mozambique, Namibia, Rwanda, South Africa, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia & Zimbabwe

access.quote: has an open funding opportunity for projects that involve direct rhino conservation interventions

window.quote: we accept proposals submitted to grants@rhinos.org on a rolling basis

effort.quote: we accept proposals submitted to grants@rhinos.org on a rolling basis.
Upon receipt, IRF will communicate with the IUCN-SSC African Rhino Specialist Group to jointly review the application.

eligibility.quote: This fund is intended to help ensure success for projects supporting recently translocated rhino populations, populations targeted for future range expansion, or initiatives that have broader national or regional impacts on rhino range expansion in general.

after_award.quote: At a minimum, each grant recipient will be required to submit a report to IRF 13 months after the grantee receives RREF funds (including a 1 page financial report).

eligibility.rule: Support recently translocated rhinos, populations targeted for expansion, or wider national or regional range expansion.
